title: Product KPIs — PEO CustomReport
description: Leadership-readable KPIs distinct from the engineering telemetry on the tRPC Latency dashboard. Audience: head + admin + viewer. Source code: apps/api/src/infrastructure/metrics/metrics.registry.ts (customreport_* series).

panels.title: Reports submitted (weekly)
panels.description: Volume of report transitions into the `published` state, bucketed by week. Manual + auto publishes aggregated together; combine with `publishedById` data in the app for the manual-vs-auto split.

panels.title: On-time ratio (last 4 published periods)
panels.description: Fraction of submitted sections that landed on time (`late=false`) across the four most-recent published periods. Mirrors the `late` badge in the head dashboard. Green ≥ 80%, yellow 60-80%, red < 60%.

panels.title: Active leads (last period)
panels.description: Distinct lead authors who submitted a section in the most recently published period. Engagement signal; pairs with publish volume to distinguish 'more leads' from 'same leads filing more often'.

panels.title: Late vs on-time sections (7d rate)
panels.description: Per-section submission rate, split by the on-time flag stamped at submit time. Stacked bars surface the share of late submissions across the rolling window.

panels.title: Reopen request funnel (7d rate)
panels.description: Three-stat funnel: requested / approved / rejected over the last 7 days. Demand (requested) vs head policy stance (approve/reject ratio). A spiking 'requested' with a stable 'approved' is a process signal — leads pushing back on the deadline.

panels.title: PDF exports by role (24h rate)
panels.description: PDF export requests grouped by requesting role over the last 24 hours. Healthy product sees viewer + head pulling exports; an unhealthy one sees only head pulling on behalf of the director.

panels.title: Section submission latency distribution (signed seconds)
panels.description: Heatmap of (deadline − submittedAt). Buckets to the left of 0 = submitted early; buckets to the right = late. A heavy left-side mass is healthy; a creeping right-side tail is the early warning for missed deadlines.
